topics.title: Goldman Family Phone-In Chaos
topics.summary: A chaotic phone-in segment erupts after a caller accuses the Goldman family of receiving their entire check, fueled by bizarre accusations about O.J. Simpson and fabricated claims involving Princess Stein and Brian Adams performing for topless women. The conversation descends into increasingly outlandish speculation regarding infidelity and sexual encounters.

topics.title: Radio Trivia Game with Homeless Contestant
topics.summary: A radio show hosts a trivia game featuring several contestants, including Big Black. The questions range from general knowledge (capital of the US) to movie titles and celebrity details, leading to humorous exchanges and bets between participants. Ultimately, Big Black correctly answers most questions, winning $20.

topics.title: Rapid-Fire Question Game Show
topics.summary: A chaotic game show segment features rapid-fire questions across diverse topics, with contestants struggling to answer correctly. Bets escalate as they fail geography and history challenges, including the definition of a woman married to a king, leading to numerous incorrect answers and increasingly large wagers.

topics.title: Radio Guessing Game - Cranium Injury
topics.summary: During an informal radio segment, hosts engage in a guessing game about whether a guest can identify the location of bodily injury – specifically where one would hurt their cranium. The conversation quickly devolves into bets and speculation regarding the guest’s knowledge, with participants offering varying amounts of money while debating his ability to answer correctly.

topics.title: Trivia Game Chaos
topics.summary: A group of people play trivia with increasingly bizarre questions, leading to arguments over geography, paper composition, and personal anecdotes. The conversation abruptly shifts into legal disputes regarding child support payments and accusations of racism before concluding with a discussion about movie releases and dating experiences.

topics.title: Paternity, Crack Use & Space Exploration
topics.summary: A Fairfax Virginia woman files a paternity suit seeking $10,000 monthly child support due to the boy’s learning difficulties. A man admits to using crack while taking pictures of his deceased son after murder; John Glenn prepares for space travel and discussions about commercial advertising and model Barry Smither's demanding career continue.
